text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English says \"The duties of the NSC are described in detail...\" while French says \"Les tâches de la CSN sont définies plus précisément...\" — different terms for duties/tasks and different acronyms (NSC vs CSN)", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "The duties of the NSC are described in detail in Articles 2 to 5 of the NSC Ordinance", "before": ""}, "tgt": {"quote": "Les tâches de la CSN sont définies plus précisément aux art. 2 à 5 de d'OCSN.", "before": ""}, "severity": 0.8}, {"reason": "English says \"Its annual reports are subsequently published\" while French says \"Celui-ci est publié\" — \"Its\" refers to the report, but French uses \"Celui-ci\" which is more specific to the immediately preceding noun (the report), but the meaning is equivalent", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "Its annual reports are subsequently published", "before": "and encompass the following main activities:"}, "tgt": {"quote": "Celui-ci est publié.", "before": "Elles comprennent les activités suivantes:"}, "severity": 0.2}]}
